انغسلوا (form VII)
# اِنْغَسَلُوا (inḡasalū) /in.ɣa.sa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# اِنْغَسِلُوا (inḡasilū) /in.ɣa.si.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
